messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Gabapentin works by calming overactive electrical signals in the brain and nervous system.
Gabapentin does this by binding to the alpha-2-delta subunit of calcium channels in nerve cells.
This subunit is thought to normalize chemical signals nerves send to each other.
This results in a calmer, less excitable nerve circuit.
That same effect helps in different ways depending on what gabapentin is treating:
Epilepsy - dampens the runaway electrical firing that causes seizures.
Postherpetic neuralgia (shingles nerve pain) - reduces the abnormal pain signals from nerves damaged by shingles.
Restless legs syndrome (gabapentin enacarbil / Horizant) has an exact mechanism that is less clear.
The same calming effect on overactive nerves is thought to ease the urge-to-move sensation.
Gabapentin is not an opioid, sedative, or anti-inflammatory painkiller.
Gabapentin works directly on the nerves.
Gabapentin helps nerve-related pain.
Gabapentin isn't useful for everyday pain like headaches or sprains.
Most people need 1 to 2 weeks of regular dosing for the full effect to build up.
Triplet: ["Gabapentin", "has recommended dose duration", "1 to 2 weeks of regular dosing for the full effect to build up"]

The relation 'has recommended dose duration' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires the specified duration of regular dosing for its full therapeutic effect to be achieved.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has clearance time': The subject drug requires the time period specified by the object entity to be fully cleared from the body.
B. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
C. 'has administration time': The subject dosage form takes the specified amount of time to administer.
D. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
E. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
